# dspc_postgresql (Data Source)

Retrieves a PostgreSQL instance in the DSPC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an existing PostgreSQL instance
data "dspc_postgresql" "existing" {
  name = "my-postgres-db"
}

# Output the instance details
output "postgresql_sku_size" {
  description = "The sku size of the PostgreSQL instance"
  value       = data.dspc_postgresql.existing.sku_size
}

output "postgresql_version" {
  description = "The version of the PostgreSQL instance"
  value       = data.dspc_postgresql.existing.version
}

output "postgresql_vpc_id" {
  description = "The VPC of the PostgreSQL instance"
  value       = data.dspc_postgresql.existing.vpc_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the database instance to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `sku_size` (String) Sku size per instance node, e.g. gp-2, gp-4, etc
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags applied to the database instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `version` (String) Version of the database engine. One of: POSTGRES_15, POSTGRES_16, POSTGRES_17, POSTGRES_18.
- `vpc_id` (String) GUID of the VPC network where this database should be added to.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Tag key.
- `value` (String) Tag value.
